description: Run axe-core on a live page (WCAG 2.2 AA by default) and return violations worst first, each with the offending elements as verified Playwright locators, the fix, and a regression check to paste into a spec. Accepts storageState/headers/actions to audit pages behind a login or after a step.

actionTimeoutMs.description: How long each action waits for its element (default 10000); keep timeoutMs above the total

actions.description: Steps run in order after load to reach a state (modal, step 3). One call = one fresh browser, so include the login steps; end with a 'wait' on what the state shows

locator.description: Locator or selector, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' })

value.description: fill text, press key, select option; switchTab: 'last' (default), 'first', a 1-based number, or text in the tab's URL or title

blockResources.description: Skip these requests for speed and privacy: image, media, font, stylesheet, trackers (known analytics/ad hosts); default PW_MCP_BLOCK_RESOURCES

blockWrites.description: Abort POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests no mock answers, so steps cannot change real data (default: PW_MCP_BLOCK_WRITES)

channel.description: Branded Chromium to launch instead of the bundled one (must be installed)

connect.description: Remote browser: Playwright ws(s):// endpoint or 'cdp:<url>'; keys as {{env:E2E_…}}

device.description: Playwright device preset, e.g. 'iPhone 15', 'Pixel 7', 'iPad Pro 11' (viewport, user agent, touch)

mode.description: 'replay' (default) answers requests from the file; 'record' saves the traffic

notFound.description: replay: requests missing from the file abort (default) or go to the network

minImpact.description: Hide violations below this impact (default: minor, show all)

offline.description: Go offline once the page has loaded, before steps run, to check offline and retry states

projectRoot.description: Project whose Playwright launches the browser (default: server root)

routes.description: Network mocks, first match wins: json/body/status fulfil, abort fails, delayMs alone slows the real request

selector.description: CSS selector: audit only this part of the page

standard.description: Rule set: WCAG level (default wcag22aa, i.e. 2.0–2.2 A+AA), 'best-practice' adds axe's extra rules, 'all' runs everything

storageState.description: Logged-in session: storageState JSON inside the project, e.g. playwright/.auth/user.json

url.description: Full URL of the page to audit (http/https)

name: audit-accessibility

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Audit page accessibility
